visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair and a black hoodie is shown from the shoulders up, positioned in a room with blue curtains. Above him, a small circular insert shows the same man holding a yellow microphone against a dark background. (2) The man holds up a black smartphone to the camera, displaying a glowing white circular orb on its screen that pulsates slightly. He gestures with his free hand while looking toward the phone. (3) The scene maintains a consistent angle as the man rests his hand on his chin, looking contemplative while listening. The lighting is soft and primarily comes from the front, highlighting his facial features against the dark interior. (4) The camera remains static as the man continues to interact with the phone, alternating between looking at the device and the camera with varied expressions of skepticism and thought. (5) The video cuts to a solid black screen containing two lines of white text centered vertically, indicating the end of the clip and a call to action.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track begins with a gentle, major-key lo-fi beat featuring an acoustic guitar and soft electric piano. A male human voice speaks with a natural, conversational tone, introducing the concept of an AI debate. (2) A short, high-pitched digital chime sounds, followed by a resonant, clear male AI voice that responds formally. The BGM remains constant, balanced well under the vocals. (3) A similar chime triggers a return to the human speaker who uses more varied intonation and a slightly faster speech rate. Small mechanical handling sounds are audible during the transition. (4) The AI voice resumes after another chime, presenting detailed counter-arguments with very clear articulation and moderate spectral brightness. (5) The music continues steadily until the final seconds when both speech and BGM fade out simultaneously into silence.
